bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
repo=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot
stage="$repo/.worktrees/menu-hotfix-runtime-dual-20261115"
test "$(git -C "$repo" rev-parse HEAD)" = 57955cd68bb39626ebbca38d44b7bb034da6dc05 || { echo ROOT_HEAD_MOVED; exit 74; }
test ! -e "$stage" || { echo STAGE_EXISTS; exit 73; }
mkdir -p "$stage"
gh run download 43638650471 --repo seigo-gace/GateApp-Bot --name gaybbs-profile-bundle --dir "$stage"
test "$(sha256sum "$stage/gaybbs.mjs" | cut -d' ' -f1)" = 76ccecd409e9c6ec0515a3f6d8f72063b26ffedaa32c1e47cd8e7b7054109d62 || exit 74

cat > "$stage/Dockerfile" <<'DOCKER'
FROM gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local
USER root
COPY --chown=node:node gaybbs.mjs /app/gaybbs.mjs
COPY --chown=node:node publishMenuPanels.mjs /app/publishMenuPanels.mjs
USER node
DOCKER
docker build --pull=false --network none -t gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:menu-hotfix-0bbf7c6 "$stage" > "$stage/build.log" 2>&1 || { tail -25 "$stage/build.log"; exit 1; }
docker run --rm --network none --entrypoint node gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:menu-hotfix-0bbf7c6 --check /app/gaybbs.mjs
docker run --rm --network none --entrypoint node gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:menu-hotfix-0bbf7c6 --check /app/publishMenuPanels.mjs
echo DUAL_BUNDLE_STAGE=PASS
docker image inspect -f 'CANDIDATE={{.Id}}' gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:menu-hotfix-0bbf7c6
docker inspect -f 'LIVE={{.Image}} STATUS={{.State.Status}}' deploy-gaybbs-1
docker inspect -f 'PROJECT={{index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.project"}} SERVICE={{index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.service"}} FILES={{index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.project.config_files"}}' deploy-gaybbs-1
